1.consolidated_definition: dep. Deporte de atletismo hecho en una pista o terreno adyacente que incluye carreras, saltos, lanzamiento de pesas, tiro, etc. Calco de estructura, frecuente. Otros deportes, tales como boxeo, pista y campo, levantamiento de pesas y la fisicultura no siempre han tenido los apoyos necesarios
1.en_consolidated_definition: Track and field is a sport of athletics performed on a track or adjacent terrain that includes races, jumps, weight throwing, shooting, etc. Calque of structure, frequent. Other sports, such as boxing, track and field, weightlifting, and bodybuilding have not always had the necessary support.
